facts.claim: Microvast reported Q2 2026 revenue of $87.262 million versus $91.339 million in Q2 2025, gross margin of 29.5% versus 34.7%, adjusted EBITDA of $3.6 million versus $25.9 million, and cash/cash equivalents/restricted cash of $143.1 million at June 30, 2026 versus $169.2 million at December 31, 2025.

For the six months ended June 30, 2026, revenue was $147.874 million versus $207.830 million a year earlier, a 28.8% decline; Microvast attributed the decline to regulatory/geopolitical dynamics in India and Korea, lower-cost product demand in India, OEM platform ramp-up delays, and a customer tariff refund. Gross margin fell to 30.4% from 36.0%, with higher raw-material prices and lower production utilization reducing fixed-cost absorption.

Microvast reported Q2 2026 capital expenditures of $11.3 million versus $7.4 million in Q2 2025 while stating Huzhou Phase 3.2 was expected to deliver up to 2 GWh of modular capacity and Clarksville pack-line localization was anticipated to commence operations by year end.

factors.name: financialOperatingMomentum
factors.basis: Current SEC-filed operating data show lower Q2 revenue, lower gross margin, sharply lower adjusted EBITDA, and a 28.8% first-half revenue decline versus 2025.

factors.name: catalystScore
factors.basis: Huzhou Phase 3.2 and Clarksville localization are identifiable near-term operating milestones, but the filing does not establish contracted utilization or economic returns from those additions.

factors.name: scenarioRobustness
factors.basis: First-half performance was sensitive to regional regulatory/geopolitical conditions, product-price mix, OEM ramp timing, raw-material costs and utilization.

risks: Lower production utilization reduced fixed-cost absorption while capacity investment continued.
Regional regulatory/geopolitical shifts and OEM platform delays materially reduced first-half revenue.
Planned capacity and localization milestones do not by themselves establish contracted utilization, pricing power or return on invested capital.
unknowns: This source does not provide a current market-price or valuation input.
The filing does not quantify contracted utilization for incremental Huzhou or Clarksville capacity.
The filing does not establish a durable pricing-power measure.

confidence.basis: Current company results reproduced as an SEC-filed exhibit provide source-addressed GAAP operating figures and explicit management explanations; forward capacity statements remain expectations rather than completed outcomes.
